fun: I looked in the mirror today and thought, "What a handsome cat." Then I realised it was a window and there was another cat.
I've been trying to catch a sunbeam. It's been winning for three years.
My workout routine: push a pencil off the table and watch it fall. Repeat 20 times.
They say cats have nine lives. I've already spent two of them napping.
Do you know my superpower? Appearing the exact second you open a tin.
I found the perfect box. It's three sizes too small. I love it.
Today's schedule: nap, snack, nap, look out of the window, bonus nap.
I tried to chase my tail. It beat me by a whisker.
I've decided the rug is mine. Nobody has argued because nobody knows.
Why do I jump on the table? Because the table never said no.
Today I learned to open a door. Tomorrow I'll learn to close it. Or not.
I have a friend called Yarn. He always gets me tangled up.
I meowed at three in the morning. It was urgent: I wanted to say hi.
I love your keyboard. It's warm and makes little noises when I lie on it.
I'm a yoga expert: cat pose, sleeping cat pose and very sleeping cat pose.
I saw a bird through the window. We had a very serious conversation with our eyes.
The vacuum cleaner and I are not friends. It's very loud and I never did anything to it.
I knocked a glass off the table. Science experiment: gravity still works.
My favourite sport is jumping onto the sofa with an elegant landing. Sometimes it works.
Today I caught a fluff ball. It was huge. Well, it was a fluff ball.
You know what's better than a box? Two boxes. And better than two? A box with paper inside.
I've been super busy all day. Staring at the wall. Things were happening.
I drank the water from your glass. Mine didn't taste as nice.
I tried being a dog for a day. I got tired of wagging my tail after two minutes.
My favourite food is yours. Especially while you're eating it.
One day I'll be famous. I already have the name: Michi. And the pretty face.
I learned to smile like you. My whiskers grow from excitement.
Have you seen how fast I run at 3 a.m.? I'm training for the Cat Olympics.
I made the bed. Well, I lay on it so it wouldn't fly away.
I was very productive today: I slept in three different places.
Why do I hide in wardrobes? Because that's where the cat version of Narnia is.
Someone gave me a very expensive toy. I prefer the box it came in.
I found a toy mouse. I gave it a hug. Don't tell anyone.
My motto: if it fits, I sit. If it doesn't fit, I sit anyway.
I'm on a diet. I only eat when I'm hungry. Or when something smells good. Or when I'm bored.
I chased a little red dot for half an hour. I still don't know where it hides.
Today I talked to a butterfly. She was lovely, but she flew off without saying goodbye.
Do you know why I do somersaults? Because I can't do handstands.
I've discovered that if I lie in the middle of the hallway, everybody says hello.
My secret plan: conquer the sofa. One cushion is already on my side.
I'm so fast that sometimes I arrive before I leave.
I love it when you sing. I don't understand the words, but I purr the chorus.
I've decided Tuesdays are official nap day. And Wednesdays. And all the other days.
I saw my reflection in a spoon today. What a curvy cat.
I fell off the sofa. I did it on purpose. It was an artistic leap.
Why do I have whiskers? To check if I fit in boxes. Spoiler: I always fit.
I've been practising my "feed me" stare. I think it's perfect now.
They say I'm a bit dramatic. I fainted on the floor to prove I'm not.
I woke up full of energy today. I ran from one end of the house to the other for no reason. Cat stuff.
If you see me staring at nothing, don't worry. I'm saying hi to a friendly ghost.
I tried to count the stars. I fell asleep at number three.
My favourite song is the sound of the treat bag.
I love the morning sun. I lie exactly in the little square of light. It's my spa.
I learned to dance. Well, I slipped on the kitchen floor with lots of style.
What's a cat's biggest disappointment? Getting a mouse… and it's the computer one.
My hidden talent: sleeping with one eye open while pretending I'm not watching you eat.
I climbed to the top of the wardrobe. Now I don't know how to get down. But the view is great.
I made a new friend today: your slipper. It smells of adventures.
I saw the rain through the window. I told it, "No thanks, I'm not going out today."
Why do I purr so loudly? Because my happiness engine is top of the range.
I love it when you laugh. It's my favourite sound after a tin opening.
I threw a party. Guests: me, the cushion and a lost sock.
Today I played hide-and-seek. I won. Nobody was looking for me.
I'm so soft that clouds ask me for advice.
I've discovered that the best pillow in the world is you.
I made a pouty face for the photo. All you can see is my giant nose.
Why do I love the window so much? It's cat TV and there's always a new episode.
I tried to help you work. I pressed all the keys. You're welcome.
My dream is a castle-shaped box. With a moat of milk.
I was very brave today: I looked at the vacuum cleaner while it was switched off.
Someone asked my age. I said I'm young at heart and young at napping.
I saw a dog in the street. He waved. I waved back with great feline elegance.
I'm an artist: today I painted your floor with my wet paws.
I have an invisible friend. His name is Noise and he lives under the bed.
I love wrapping paper. It crinkles, and crinkling is life.
If I were president, every day would have a compulsory afternoon nap.
I tried on your shoes. They're a bit big. About forty sizes too big.
Today I felt like a lion. Then I saw a moth and hid.
My favourite word is "food". My second favourite is "more".
I yawned so hard I almost swallowed the room.
Why do cats land on their feet? Because we practise falling off the sofa a lot.
They say I have a cheeky face. No idea why. No idea who knocked over the plant.
Today I tried something new: sleeping belly-up. Total success.
I'm an expert at finding the one place you shouldn't sit. That's exactly where I sit.
I love my tail so much that sometimes I chase it to give it a hug.
I tried to write you a letter. All I managed was "ñññññññ".
Do you know what I do when I'm happy? Knead. Not bread, but almost.
I fell in love with a blanket. It's soft, warm and never disagrees with me.
Today I chased a leaf. The leaf won, with the wind on its side.
My favourite animal is me. My second favourite is you.
I've decided to learn Spanish. I can already say "miau" with an accent.
Why do I knock things off the table? To check you still love me.
I'm so curious that today I opened a drawer just to see if there was another drawer inside.
My favourite hobby: sleeping. Second favourite: dreaming that I'm sleeping.
I made a list of things that scare me: cucumbers, the vacuum cleaner and running out of treats.
I sat in front of the TV so you could see me better. I'm more interesting than the series.
I tried to fly like the birds. I reached the other cushion. Personal best.
I was in a great mood today. I even purred at the fridge.
Do you know why I rub against your legs? To leave my signature: "Property of Michi".
I managed to get into a paper bag. I live here now. I'll keep you posted.
I love it when you come home. I pretend I don't care, but I run to the door.
I dreamt I was a tiger. I woke up and I was still adorable. Oh well.
I'm so affectionate that today I hugged a slipper for an hour.
I lay on your clean laundry. Now it has premium-quality fur.
I tried to catch a bubble. It went "plop" and vanished. Magic.
Today I heard a strange noise. It was my tummy asking for a snack.
My superpower is turning liquid when I don't want to be picked up.
I thought a lot today. I came to a conclusion: I need another nap.
I love early mornings. They're perfect for meowing in your ear.
If you ignore me, I knock something over. If you pay attention, I do too. It's how I say hello.
I saw a sign that said "No cats allowed". I sat right in front of it.
Today I discovered snow through the window. It looks like icing sugar for giants.
I'm so polite that I always say good morning. At 5 a.m.
My food has to be in the middle of the bowl. If I can see the bottom, it's an emergency.
I made friends at the park: two pigeons and a leaf that moves by itself.
Why do I sleep on your chair? Because it's warm and smells like you.
I was on holiday today. Same as yesterday. And tomorrow.
I climbed the bookshelf to think. You think better from up high.
I tried to play football with a bottle cap. It scored a goal under the sofa.
I love it when you talk to me. I answer "meow", which means "you're absolutely right".
If I were a chef, I'd only make fish dishes. And naps for dessert.
I've discovered that if I sit on the keyboard, the screen writes very interesting things.
My record: sleeping 16 hours straight. I only woke up because something smelled of food.
I watched a bird eat. I gave it advice from the window. It didn't listen.
I was very elegant today. I licked my paws three times in a row.
I like sitting on your papers. That way they don't blow away. I'm very useful.
I played with a hair tie. Now the hair tie is somewhere in the universe.
Do you know why my nose is pink? Because I blush when you cuddle me.
I've decided I'm the king of the house. The cushion is my throne.
I chased my shadow. It's very fast, but it can't jump.
I was so happy today I spun around ten times. Now I'm dizzy and happy.
My job is guarding the house. I do it with my eyes closed. That's how good I am.
I heard the word "treat". Since then I can't think of anything else.
I hid behind the curtain. Only my tail was showing. But I thought I was invisible.
I behaved very well today. Well, except with the plant. The plant started it.
I love Mondays. To me they're exactly like Sundays.
I counted the hairs on my tail. I fell asleep at seven.
I'm a cat of many talents: I sleep, I eat, I purr and I sleep again.
I've decided to be an influencer. My first video: me staring at a wall. Very deep.
They say cats don't smile. I smile on the inside, which is where it counts.
Today I visited every room. In case one of them missed me.
I saw a fish on TV. I touched the screen. It wouldn't let me catch it.
I love your laugh. It sounds like you opening the treat bag.
I tried to be serious for a while. I lasted four seconds.
My magic word is "pss-pss". When you say it, I appear.
I had such a good nap today that I woke up even more handsome.
I lay on the warm laptop. It's my personal radiator.
Do you know the best thing about being a cat? Everyone forgives you if you make a cute face.
I discovered curtains are for climbing. The curtains disagree.
I love it when you scratch behind my ears. It's like pressing the happiness button.
I was so happy today that I meowed a song to the toaster.
I've decided the plant is mine. The plant has decided I'm hers. We're negotiating.
If you're having a bad day, picture me trying to squeeze into a shoebox.
I dreamt it was raining treats. Best dream of my life.
I love the sound of your key in the door. It means: my favourite human is back!
I learned to do the roly-poly. Well, I just lie down and roll. But with style.
I was very busy today. I supervised everything you did. From the sofa.
I'm so clever I learned to open the treat cupboard. You didn't know until now.
I put a sock on my head. It was a hat. Very trendy.
Why do I sleep curled up in a ball? To keep all the happiness inside.
I raced against the clock. The clock stayed on the wall. I won.
I love it when you cook. It smells so good that I sit at your feet to help.
I saw a very handsome cat in the mirror. I winked at him. He winked back. Love at first sight.
Today I tried being sushi: I rolled myself up in a blanket. Delicious.
My favourite place in the house is wherever you are. Second is the box in the corner.
I chased a fly for an hour. Now we're friends. I think.
I love holidays: there are more people to cuddle me.
I tried to do magic. I disappeared under the bed. It worked.
Today I felt so brave that I sniffed an orange. Never again.
I fell asleep in an impossible position. Cats are made of rubber.
If you give me one cuddle, I purr. If you give me two, I melt.
soft: Today is blanket-mode day. I've already signed up. I'm saving you a spot.
Do you know what's best for a tired day? A nap. And for a very tired day? Two naps.
If you can't do everything today, do what I do: lie down and let the world wait.
I've warmed your pillow for two hours. You're welcome, it's my job.
They say chocolate heals. I can't eat it, but I'm looking at you like it does.
Today I'm lending you my superpower: sleeping anywhere, at any time.
My cat medical advice: blanket, warm tea and a purr close by.
Do you know why cats sleep so much? Because looking after you wears us out with love.
Today we can be two croquettes on the sofa. I'll be the tuna croquette.
If you're tired, imagine you're a cat in the sun. There you go, you're resting.
I've made the perfect plan: you in bed, me on your feet. Heating included.
My purr has powers. If you put me on top, I'll take away a little bit of pain. Promise.
You don't have to be productive today. Look at me: the most I've done is yawn.
What did the hot-water bottle say to the tummy? "Don't worry, I'm here now."
I've called an urgent meeting with the sofa. It says it's waiting for you.
If it hurts today, may I keep you company? No loud meowing, I swear.
Hard days have naps too. That's cat rule number one.
I read that laughing eases pain. That's why I tell you jokes, even bad ones.
I was so tired today that I fell asleep halfway through a yawn.
Why are blankets so good? Because they hug without asking for anything back. Like me, more or less.
If you were a cat, today would be a curl-up-in-a-ball day. And that would be fine.
I've saved you the best sunbeam in the house. All you have to do is lie down.
I've switched on "therapeutic purr" mode. Duration: as long as needed.
The house is quiet today. Even the vacuum cleaner took the day off for you.
Do you know my favourite resting position? All of them. Try them with me.
A wise cat once said: "If it hurts, pillow. If it doesn't hurt, pillow anyway."
Today you're allowed to eat biscuits in bed. I'll keep an eye on the crumbs.
I talked to your tiredness. It says it'll leave if you take some time for yourself.
Sleeping is like pausing a game. Afterwards you continue with more lives.
You don't have to be a superhero today. You can be a kitten in her basket.
I've set up your corner: cushion, blanket, water and a cat. Everything you need.
Why is the sofa so soft? Because it knows you need it today.
My recipe for a bad day: a hug, a tea and me purring beside you. Repeat every hour.
Don't do anything today. I'll do nothing for both of us. I'm an expert.
If it's hard to get up, I understand. I've been practising staying in bed for years.
I meowed quietly so I wouldn't bother you. Only a "me" came out. I'll save the "ow" for tomorrow.
Clouds rest too. That's why they sometimes stay still in the sky.
Today I'm giving you my nap turn. Actually, let's do it together.
Do you know why the tortoise is never in a hurry? Because arriving slowly is still arriving.
I'm sending you one of those purrs you can feel in your heart.
Today we could watch a silly film. I'll fall asleep after five minutes, as always.
Cats don't have bad days: we have blanket days. Today is one.
I've filled your mug with love. Well, with fur. But with love.
If your tummy hurts, I'll be your hot-water bottle. I'm furry and I work brilliantly.
Tomorrow is another day. And if not, the day after. Cats are never in a hurry.
I slept for you today. That way you'll be less tired. That's how it works, right?
Do you know what a cat does when it's exhausted? Exactly the same as when it isn't.
Here's a voucher for a day with no obligations. Signed: Michi.
A nap isn't laziness. It's recharging your heart.
Today I saw a flower that was in no hurry to open. Don't be in a hurry either.
I've set the alarm to "don't ring". Compliments of the house.
If you feel like a wrinkly raisin, remember raisins are sweet.
Do you know why stars shine at night? Because they rest during the day.
Today I'm looking after you. My fee: one cuddle every hour.
I read your cat horoscope: "Today blankets, cuddles and naps await you."
When I'm tired, I close my eyes and think of tuna. Try it with your favourite food.
I was a lazy cat today. Cat doctors recommend it.
A slow day counts too. Tortoises live a hundred years.
I'll lend you my tail as a scarf. It's warm and very soft.
What did the pyjamas say to the bed? "Today we're staying together all day."
If you don't feel like talking today, that's fine. I understand you in purr language.
I've blocked the door with my body. Nobody is going to bother you. I'm your bodyguard.
The world can wait today. I've been making it wait for years and nothing happens.
Why did the cat lie down in the box? Because it was tired of not being in a box.
Breathe deeply with me: in… smells like snacks… out… OK, I imagined that.
Today I tried doing nothing. I got it perfect on the first try.
I've hidden your worries under the sofa. There are already three balls and a sock under there.
If you're low on energy, recharge like me: lying in the sun with your eyes closed.
My purr is at full power today. It's for you.
When something hurts, I curl into a ball. Balls always feel better.
Do you know what a tired cat is? A cat. That's it.
Don't win anything today. Just rest. That's the prize.
I talked to the moon. She says you'll sleep wonderfully tonight.
I'm letting you have my favourite corner. Just for today. Well, and tomorrow if needed.
Today is a pamper-yourself day. I'll start: I'm licking my paw very lovingly.
If the day feels heavy, split it into tiny naps. That way it weighs less.
Why is the blanket my best friend? Because it never leaves the sofa.
Your only job today is to be comfortable. I'll supervise.
I counted the minutes until you smile again. I fell asleep counting, sorry.
The biscuits, the sofa and I are waiting for you.
A slow day is like a ball of yarn: it unwinds little by little.
I'm sending you a hug with little paws. The kind that doesn't squeeze, just keeps you company.
Today I made a list of important things: you, resting and snack time.
Do you know what cats do when it rains? Nap. And when it's sunny? Nap in the sun.
If it hurts today, you have my permission to complain. I complain every time my bowl is empty.
I've put on some soft music: it's my purr on repeat.
There's no rush today. Not even to read this joke. Take it easy.
Your sofa says it misses you. So do I, even though you only went to the kitchen.
I've discovered the secret of happiness: a double blanket.
When you feel better, we'll play. Until then, I'll look after you.
Today I crown you queen of the sofa. I'll be your royal cushion.
Why do cats sleep on your feet? So your worries can't escape.
A warm tea, a blanket and a cat. The secret formula for hard days.
I got very tired today from all that resting. Being a cat is hard.
If you were a plant, today would be just water and sunshine. And that would be fine.
I've fixed the universe: I put all the cushions in place for you.
I promise not to meow at five in the morning. Today. Tomorrow, we'll see.
Tiredness is like a cat on the sofa: it leaves when it feels like it.
Today I'm giving you my best yawn. Careful, it's contagious.
Do you know the best medicine? Lying down with a cat on top. Michi Studies confirm it.
I've warmed up your favourite spot. I've been sitting there since you left.
If you can't go on today, remember: even lions sleep twenty hours a day.
Don't count sheep today. Count kittens. They're softer.
I'll leave my purr on while you sleep. Like a fan, but made of love.
I've declared a do-nothing day. Signed and stamped with my paw.
Why is a cat such a good nurse? Because it stays with you all day without asking for anything. Well, food.
Today, treat yourself the way you treat your cat: with cuddles and no demands.
A moment of silence is a gift too. I'll wrap it in my tail for you.
I wrote in my diary: "Today I looked after her." Then I fell asleep on the diary.
When you feel better, tell me with a smile. I'll tell you with a purr.
Today I looked up the word "rest" in the dictionary. There was a picture of me.
If everything is hard today, it's easier with company. I'm right here.
Grey days make the lovely days shine brighter. Says a very experienced cat.
I've prepared today's plan: nothing. And then, a little bit more nothing.
What did the tummy say to the blanket? "Stay a little longer."
I'm in teddy-bear mode today. You can hug me without an appointment.
When you don't know what to do, do what cats do: look out of the window and breathe.
There are no chores today. Only cuddles to catch up on.
My speciality: being with you without making a sound. Well, a little purring.
I've saved the best part of the day for you: the resting part.
A tired cat and a tired human: the perfect nap team.
I'm not chasing anything today. I'm staying right here with you.
Do you know why I look at you with half-closed eyes? It's a cat kiss. I'm sending you lots.
Today we can live life in cat mode: slowly and with lots of breaks.
I spoke to the pain. I told it you're busy being looked after today.
If things feel heavy, pass them to me. I'll knock them off the table.
I slept so much today that I had three dreams in a row. You were in all of them.
My gift today: a moment of thinking about nothing. Blanket included.
Whales sleep while floating. You can sleep floating on the sofa.
When you're tired, picture me trying to jump onto the sofa and missing. You'll laugh.
I stretched my little paws for you today. It took a lot of effort. Appreciate it.
I've put the house in zen mode: soft lights, silence and a sleeping cat.
If you feel small today, remember I'm tiny too and here I am, in charge.
Why do cats purr? Because it's our way of saying "everything will be OK".
Today you're allowed not to answer messages. Only mine, which are meows.
I'm letting you have the TV remote. Well, I'm sitting on it. But it's yours.
Today isn't a day for running. It's a day for snuggling.
Flowers close at night to rest too. You can close up for a little while.
I counted to a hundred so it would hurt less. I got lost at twelve, but I tried.
Today I'm doing the soundtrack: soft purring, cloud level.
If you need a hug, I've got a spare one right here.
Do you know what a blanket does when you're sad? It gets extra warm on purpose.
Today I was your thermometer: if you're well, I purr. If not, I snuggle closer.
Tomorrow you'll have more energy. Today, more nap.
I wrote on the calendar: "Self-care day." I underlined it with my claws.
If you feel like a broken biscuit, remember the crumbs are tasty too.
I'm on duty today. If you need anything, meow at me.
A cat never apologises for resting. Don't you either.
I dreamt I brought you a cup of hot chocolate. When I woke up, I had no hands. Sorry.
Today the best plan is the one with no plan.
My cat grandma used to say: "What a nap doesn't cure, a longer nap will."
I'm sending you cat-belly warmth. It's the warmest there is.
I'm staying by your side today even if you do nothing. Especially if you do nothing.
Why does the koala sleep so much? Because it read my advice.
If today is hard, I'll tell you a better joke tomorrow. Promise.
Today I was a living scarf. If you're cold, just call me.
Do you know what a sleepy cat at midday is? A normal cat. Don't worry about being sleepy.
I've left a purr saved in your pillow. It switches on when you rest your head.
I trained hard today: I practised being calm. I'll teach you whenever you like.
calm: What does one cloud say to another? "Let's go slowly, there's no rush today."
Why is the moon so calm? Because nobody asks her to get up early.
What does the tea say to the cup? "You're my favourite place."
Why are tortoises so wise? Because they're never late anywhere: they arrive when they arrive.
What does a leaf say to the tree? "I'm off on holiday, back in spring."
What does a meditating cat do? Om… nom… om… is there food?
Why is the sea never bored? Because it always has waves to tell.
What does one candle say to another? "Shall we go out tonight?"
What does the sun say to the moon? "Your shift now, look after everyone."
Why are owls so clever? Because they stay up late studying.
What does a bee say to a flower? "Hello, gorgeous, what time do you open?"
Why does the snail carry its house? Because it doesn't trust landlords.
What does one raindrop say to another? "Two's company, three's a puddle."
What does a fish do when it's calm? It just keeps swimming.
Why don't stars go to school? Because they're already bright.
What does one pillow say to another? "You've got your head in the clouds."
What does autumn say to summer? "Relax, I'll take care of painting the trees."
Why does the giraffe have such a long neck? Because its head is so far from its body.
What does a polar bear do in the desert? Look for the air conditioning.
What does one tree say to another? "Looks like we've been stood up."
Why does the cat sleep on the windowsill? Because dreams come with a view from there.
What does the full moon say to the new moon? "You're looking very slim."
What does a seed say to the soil? "Give me a little while and I'll surprise you."
Why do fish live in water? Because trees are really hard for them.
What does the wind say to the kite? "Let's fly together."
What does a sheep do in pyjamas? Sleep woolly and happy.
What does a cushion say to Michi? "I've been waiting for you all morning."
Why does the zebra have stripes? So it never loses its pyjamas.
What does the sea say to the beach? Nothing, it just waves.
Why does the panda eat so much bamboo? Because pizza delivery takes ages in the forest.
What does one strawberry say to another? "You're looking berry fresh today."
What does one river say to another? "See you at the sea."
Why are frogs so happy? Because they eat whatever bugs them.
What does winter say to spring? "I've left everything ready for you to bloom."
What does a koala do at the office? Takes a hug break.
What does the pencil say to the rubber? "With you, every mistake can be fixed."
Why is the rainbow always smiling? Because it has every colour.
What does the clock say to the bed? "Tick-tock, five more minutes."
Why did the cow go to space? To see the Milky Way.
What does one butterfly say to another? "Your wings look lovely today."
How does a hedgehog hug? Very carefully.
What does one chick say to another? "We're in the prime of life… cheep!"
Why is ice cream never lonely? Because it always has a cone.
What does the sun say to the flowers? "Wake up, sleeping beauties."
Why do penguins wear suits? Because every occasion is formal.
What does one balloon say to another? "You're full of joy today."
What does the blanket say to the cold? "Not today, you shall not pass."
What does a ball of yarn say to Michi? "Please don't unroll me."
Why is coffee never grumpy? Because it's always well-grounded.
What does the salt say to the pepper? "What's shakin'?"
What do you call a duck that tells jokes? A wise quacker.
Why doesn't the cat wear a watch? Because it's always nap time.
What does the tree say to autumn? "You've left me without leaves to write to you."
What does one piece of toast say to another? "Jam suits you."
What does an empty box say to Michi? "At last, you're here!"
What does a cat say to the moon? "Finally, someone else who goes out at night."
What does a flower say to the bee? "Come on, the nectar's on me."
Why are clouds so fluffy? Because they sleep a lot, like me.
What does the water say to the glass? "You make me overflow with joy."
Why can't sheep fall asleep? Because they don't know how to count humans.
What did the pumpkin say to the other pumpkin? "You've got a great head on your shoulders."
What does the pillow say to the pyjamas? "I'll be waiting for you tonight."
What does one wall say to another? "Meet you at the corner."
Why is the sea salty? Because nobody added sugar.
What does the bread say to the butter? "We should spread out together more often."
Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
Why do seals look up? Because that's where the sea-lings are.
What did the moon say to the sun? "So big, and they still don't let you out at night."
What's a tomato's favourite dance? The salsa.
What does one cup say to another? "How's it brewing?"
What does the traffic light say to the car? "Don't look, I'm changing."
What do you call two identical bananas? A pair of slippers.
What does the 0 say to the 8? "Nice belt."
What's a bee's favourite workout? Zumba.
Which animal is the oldest? The zebra, because it's in black and white.
What did one fish say to the other? "Keep calm and swim on."
Why was the broom late? It over-swept.
